recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining FHIR-32445 source gap without reintroducing old numeric AuditEvent outcome codes or duplicating related FHIR-32446/FHIR-32447 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-32445 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 after asking why AuditEvent.outcome used unusual DICOM numeric outcome codes. The accepted resolution moved the value set toward OperationOutcome issue-severity plus success and required the AuditEvent.outcome comment to document the DICOM mapping 0=success, 4=warning, 8=error, and 12=fatal.
initial_application: Commit 04aebbe0d4, explicitly tagged FHIR-32445, removed the old minor/serious/major numeric AuditEvent outcome concepts and added issue-severity to the AuditEvent outcome value set, but did not add the requested DICOM mapping to the AuditEvent StructureDefinition comment. Later FHIR-39622 commits added success to issue-severity and removed the separate AuditEvent success-code include, leaving the current value set based on issue-severity alone.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes auditevent=AuditEvent, so source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml and the AuditEvent outcome value set are current build inputs. Related combined-branch reconciliations already covered FHIR-32446, which was resolved with FHIR-32445, and FHIR-32447, which corrected the current outcome backbone/code model and required binding. Security block-vote/minutes evidence supported the Jira disposition, and no conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml so both AuditEvent.outcome and AuditEvent.outcome.code comments include the DICOM AuditMessage EventOutcomeIndicator mapping: 0 maps to success, 4 maps to warning, 8 maps to error, and 12 maps to fatal. No terminology source was changed because the current issue-severity-based value set already represents the applied and later-updated terminology model.
source_changes: source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml: added the DICOM EventOutcomeIndicator mapping note to AuditEvent.outcome and AuditEvent.outcome.code comments.
